explanation.primary_cause: The dominant source (sparepartsworld, 96.5% of fitments) publishes part rows without a diagram section. Its configuration keys are machine variants (LOOP_HANDLE, ELECTRIC, D), not sections, so section_key cannot be derived from that source.
explanation.secondary_cause: 81,565 of those fitments carry no configuration key at all; the source page is a single model-wide parts list.
explanation.fail_closed_behaviour: The importer correctly refuses to guess and stores general_unresolved instead of inventing a section.

improvement_levers.action: Treat missing artwork as a data quality problem: replace placeholder URLs per model before counting coverage
improvement_levers.measured_effect: 42 of 61 pilot URLs are placeholders (68.85%); the real sheet count is ~1109 of 2376

improvement_levers.action: Reuse resolved GHS section identity for sparepartsworld rows with the same model + part number
improvement_levers.measured_effect: 1993 fitments, 775 parts, 223 models can move out of general_unresolved
improvement_levers.risk: MEDIUM — must be stored as DERIVED_FROM_SECTION_EVIDENCE, never as verified

improvement_levers.action: Resolve section identity at the source: harvest GHS section pages including their position tables
improvement_levers.measured_effect: Would bind every GHS section (2,376 URLs) to positions instead of the current 235
improvement_levers.risk: HIGH — new acquisition + rights still unresolved

improvement_levers.action: Recover sections from the local archive PDFs (78 documents) once the files are available
improvement_levers.measured_effect: 6560 indexed pages, but only 3073 have a usable heading and 1397 carry model metadata, and 0 carry part numbers
improvement_levers.risk: MEDIUM — needs OCR plus the actual PDF files
